tasks.title: Implement runPipelineCheckStage with Build & Test check
tasks.description: In `packages/cli/src/workflow/workflow-controller.ts`, replace `runPipelineReviewStage()` with `runPipelineCheckStage()`. Implement `runBuildTestCheck()` private method that: (1) runs the configured command via execFileAsync in the worktree with timeout, (2) on failure + autoFix enabled, spawns coder agent via createAcpConnection to fix errors (max 2 attempts), (3) returns CheckResult. Update the `run()` dispatch: rename `Stage.Review` case to `Stage.Check`, call `runPipelineCheckStage()`, emit `check_started`/`check_update` events for SSE. Read ChecksConfig from loaded workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: runPipelineCheckStage() runs Build & Test check first
Build command succeeds on first attempt → CheckResult status 'passed'
Build command fails + autoFix succeeds → CheckResult status 'passed', autoFixed true
Build command fails + autoFix exhausted (2 attempts) → CheckResult status 'failed'
Build command fails + autoFix disabled → CheckResult status 'failed' immediately
Build command timeout → CheckResult status 'failed' with timeout indicator
Build & Test failure stops the suite (no further checks run)
CheckResult stored in CheckSuiteOutput within approvalState.output
Stage.Check case in run() dispatches to runPipelineCheckStage()
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the core implementation task. It also wires the Stage.Check case in run() dispatch.

tasks.title: Add Merge Ready check and AI Review check to check suite
tasks.description: Add `runMergeReadyCheck()` and `runAiReviewCheck()` private methods to WorkflowController. Add `worktreeManager` to `WorkflowControllerOptions` and wire it in `agent-runner-service.ts`. `runMergeReadyCheck()`: calls `worktreeManager.canFastForward()`, returns CheckResult with informational status (always 'passed'). `runAiReviewCheck()`: migrate existing review logic from old `runPipelineReviewStage` — reviewer prompt → self-check → parseVerdict → auto-fix loop (max 2). Wrap the output as CheckResult within CheckSuiteOutput. Wire them sequentially in `runPipelineCheckStage()`: after Build & Test passes, run Merge Ready (if enabled), then AI Review (if enabled).
acceptanceCriteria: Merge Ready check calls canFastForward and returns CheckResult with 'Merge Ready: yes' or 'Merge Ready: needs rebase'
Merge Ready always returns status 'passed' (informational, non-blocking)
Merge Ready disabled via checks.ff-merge.enabled: false → skipped, no CheckResult produced
AI Review check preserves existing behavior: reviewer → self-check → verdict → auto-fix loop
AI Review PASS → CheckResult status 'passed', verdict 'PASS'
AI Review FAIL + auto-fix PASS → CheckResult status 'passed', autoFixed true
AI Review FAIL + auto-fix exhausted → CheckResult status 'failed', verdict 'FAIL'
AI Review disabled via checks.ai-review.enabled: false → skipped
All checks pass → CheckSuiteOutput.overallResult 'passed'
Any blocking check fails → CheckSuiteOutput.overallResult 'failed'
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Wire approval handler to MergeQueue instead of mergeBackFn
tasks.description: In `packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts`, modify `POST /:number/approve`: when `approvalStage === Stage.Check`, call `mergeQueue.enqueue(projectId, number)` instead of `agentRunner.resumePipeline()`. Set `mergeState = 'pending'` on the issue. Remove `mergeBackFn` from the Check stage path in `WorkflowController.run()` — the approved Check case should just return (MergeQueue handles the rest). Wire MergeQueue's `merge_completed` event in server to transition issue stage to `done`. Wire `merge_failed` event to set mergeState. Note: the existing `POST /:number/reject` endpoint already handles Check→Build stage regression (was Review→Build, now uses Stage.Check after T-001 rename) — no new endpoint needed for 'Back to Build'.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve on Check stage calls mergeQueue.enqueue(), not resumePipeline()
Issue mergeState set to 'pending' on enqueue
merge_completed event transitions issue stage to 'done'
merge_failed event sets mergeState (blocked/conflict/build-failed), stage stays 'check'
MergeQueue retry still works for failed merges
Plan stage approval still works (transitions to Build)
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Build CheckResultsPanel component
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/components/CheckResultsPanel.tsx`.
